summary: Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets in equity securities of large-capitalization companies. The managers define large-capitalization companies as companies within the Russell 1000 Growth Index at the time of purchase. The fund identifies sectors that contain the highest concentration of top-ranked individual equities. These sectors are then overweighted in the fund’s portfolio to enhance exposure to areas with favorable valuation dynamics. The fund is non-diversified.
